name: NTv3_benchmark_dataset
description:
NTv3 Benchmark Dataset
	

This dataset contains the functional tracks and genome annotations used in the NTv3 benchmark evaluation.

	
		
		Dataset Organization
	

The dataset is organized as follows:
InstaDeepAI/NTv3_benchmark_dataset/
├── <species>/
│   ├── functional_tracks/
│   │   ├── <track_name>.bigwig
│   │   └── ...
│   └── genome_annotation/
│       ├── <track_name>.bed
│       └── ...


	
		
		Available Species
	


arabidopsis
chicken
cattle
human
maize
rice
tomato… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InstaDeepAI/NTv3_benchmark_dataset.
reputation: A research-oriented genomic benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with moderate adoption among bioinformatics groups for functional-track evaluation.
